name: Anthem Biosciences Ltd
title: Anthem Biosciences Ltd - 544449 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue grew about 15% to Rs 2,124 cr with EBITDA up 31% to Rs 990 cr; management refused FY27 guidance but disclosed Unit 4 capex of about Rs 700 cr next year, lifting capacity sharply.

capex.peers_comment: Management said Korea and China large companies have built massive large-molecule capacity, ahead of Anthem.
capex.quote: we plug away at this , because I think in terms of early development, Anthem is a very, very good partner

triggers.label: Unit 4 capex ~Rs 1,200 cr over two years
triggers.quote: we are looking at investing almost about Rs. 1,200 odd crores across two years, this year FY27 and in FY28

triggers.label: Destocking behind us, restocking now
triggers.quote: the destocking that had to happen has already happened. So, this year, everything will be in the positive territory, they are restocking now.

triggers.label: No FY27 guidance given
triggers.quote: We want to refrain from giving any guidance for FY27 or FY28

triggers.label: Specialty ingredients Q4 growth 8%
triggers.quote: We delivered about 8% growth in the fourth quarter

guidance.quote: We want to refrain from giving any guidance for FY27 or FY28

guidance.value: held at 38-40% implied by delivery to date
guidance.quote: We've delivered so far, and we'll continue to deliver those numbers going forward as well.

guidance.value: about Rs 700 crore, then about Rs 500 crore
guidance.quote: Roughly about Rs. 700 crores and then post that will be about Rs. 500 crores.

prior_guidance_check.quote: a 30% EBITDA growth and 30% plus PAT growth for FY26

red_flags.label: Revenue growth missed own 20% target
red_flags.quote: Last year , we missed out on one parameter

evasions.quote: I would refrain from giving a forward -looking FY27 or a near-term guidance
We don't have order book sort of a concept in specialty ingredients
